## What's Changed * feat(sleep): auto-sleep from needsWater on FW >= 1357 by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/551 * feat(serial): connect an attached Android USB machine immediately by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/558 * fix(de1): await the DE1 refill-level transport write by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/560 * feat(macos): add Sparkle 2 auto-update with signed GitHub Pages appcast by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/563 * ci: install DYE2 plugin from allofmeng/dye2 release by @allofmeng in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/566 * Add shot-upload plugin + enable plugin Decent-proxy writes by @johnbuckman in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/565 * docs(skills): index decent-app scenarios, harden skill description by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/570 * fix(visualizer): shift state_change frame markers to non-zero by @bsnelson in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/574 * README: iPad Full support with SideStep one-click install link by @johnbuckman in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/576 * shot-upload: mark uploaded shots with annotations.extras.uploaded_to_decent by @johnbuckman in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/575 * Enhance acknowledgment section in README by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/578 * plugin-host: own, bound, and cancel plugin timers and pending async requests (#561) by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/577 * Stream backup export, import, and sync data instead of fully buffering it (issue #555) by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/569 * feat(settings): add keepAwake toggle to persist wake lock (gh-572) by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/583 * fix: handle plugin directory paths on Windows by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/592 * Update dart_js and universal_ble dependencies by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/593 * fix(plugins): protect secure settings by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/588 * fix: decouple shot startup from scale samples by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/587 * fix: report device connect command outcomes by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/591 * Simulator: honor profile limiters and vary puck resistance by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/590 * plugin-host: add complete lifecycle disposal by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/582 * fix(plugins): forward recipe and shot tags to Visualizer upload by @bsnelson in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/584 * ci: add Flutter test timing and reduce PR check overhead by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/595 * Enforce plugin manifest permissions by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/589 * chore: reduce source comments with uncomment by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/585 * feat(firmware): bundle DE1 v1358 (cold maintenance + out-of-water support) by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/594 * feat(bengle): add A013 integrated-scale telemetry by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/601
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/compare/v0.7.16...v0.7.17
